paper_metadata.title: Strength-ductility synergy of element Ru for Nb–Si based in-situ composites

evidence.quote: Nb – Si based alloys are regarded as the most potential material to substitute the Nickel-based superalloys.
Nb – 16Si – 24Ti ( x = 0 at.%)
Nb – 16Si – 24Ti – 1Ru ( x = 1 at.%)
Nb – 16Si – 24Ti – 2Ru ( x = 2 at.%)

In this study, the alloys with different contents of Ru are prepared by vacuum non-consumable melting in a high purity argon atmosphere. Moreover, The Ru with the form of powder is wrapped by the aluminum foil, and placed at the bottom of crucible to prevent its wastage in process of smelting. ... All alloys are melted five times to achieve complete homogenization of alloy elements and all the raw materials are high purity ( >= 99.95%) in this paper.

evidence.section: 4.2 Effect of Ru addition on mechanical properties
evidence.quote: With the doping of Ru, Nbss/ gamma (Nb, X)5Si3 eutectic with complex microstructure appears in the matrix of Nb – Si alloys. This can make more grain boundaries and accelerate the crack re-nucleation to form more cleavage steps, which results in more energy absorption in investigated alloys [ 39 ].
Element Ru also plays a great role of solution strengthening, and the maximum value of room compressive strength is 2012 MPa.
